### Before Abraham Was
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abraham-was
Passage: John 8:48-59
Points:
- Jesus' declaration "Before Abraham was, I am" is His most explicit claim to deity.
- True spiritual lineage to Abraham requires faith and obedience, not merely biological descent.
- The Jewish authorities recognized He was claiming to be Yahweh, which provoked their attempt to stone Him.
- True spiritual freedom comes only from abiding in Christ and resting on Him in faith.

### Do You Know Why Jesus Uses the Phrase "I Am"?
Author: Michael J. Kruger
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/do-you-know-why-jesus-uses-the-phrase-i-am-bible-study-minute-september-28-2017.html
Passage: John 8:58
Points:
- Jesus' bold statement provoked an immediate attempt to stone Him because listeners recognized a divine claim.
- While often tied to Exodus, the phrasing strongly parallels God's self-declarations in the book of Isaiah.
- Isaiah repeatedly uses "ego eimi" to emphasize the Lord's exclusive identity as the only true God.
- Jesus was not presenting Himself as an alternative deity, but as the very God of Israel.
